title: Talent Acquisition Lead
description:
**We’re Hiring \| Talent Acquisition Lead**
===========================================


**Location:** Ahmedabad, Gujarat


**Working Days:** 6 Days a Week


**Experience:** 10–15 Years


**CTC:** Up to 25 LPA


**About the Role**
------------------


AVI Renewable Energy is looking for an accomplished Talent Acquisition Lead to exclusively manage Senior Management, SBU Head, Functional Head, CXO\-level and other leadership/business\-critical hiring mandates.


The role is focused on reducing leadership hiring TAT through proactive executive search, direct headhunting, talent mapping, market intelligence and senior\-level networking.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


* Manage end\-to\-end hiring for Senior Management, Functional Heads, SBU Heads and CXO\-level roles.
* Partner with Management and Functional Heads to define leadership profiles, priorities and closure timelines.
* Develop role\-specific search strategies covering target industries, companies and candidate pools.
* Directly headhunt and engage high\-quality passive candidates through LinkedIn, networking and professional channels.
* Build and maintain leadership talent maps and succession\-ready candidate pipelines.
* Provide market intelligence on talent availability, compensation benchmarks and competitor talent.
* Assess senior candidates on leadership capability, business scale, P\&L exposure, team size, career progression and cultural fit.
* Present high\-quality calibrated shortlists and evidence\-based candidate recommendations to Management.
* Manage senior candidate engagement, compensation discussions, negotiations and joining risks.
* Handle confidential/replacement searches with complete discretion.
* Manage executive search partners where required while strengthening direct sourcing capability.
* Track leadership hiring TAT, vacancy ageing, search progress and joining risks through structured MIS.
* Lead and mentor the Talent Acquisition team.
**What We Are Looking For**
---------------------------


* Master’s / PGD in HR preferred. Engineering or Management graduates with strong Leadership Talent Acquisition experience may also be considered.
* Experience in Solar, Renewable Energy, EPC, Engineering, Manufacturing, Infrastructure, Power or related industries will be strongly preferred.
* 10–15 years of Talent Acquisition / Executive Search experience.
* Strong hands\-on experience in Senior Management, Functional Head, SBU Head and/or CXO hiring.
* Proven expertise in direct headhunting, passive\-candidate engagement and talent mapping.
* Advanced LinkedIn sourcing, networking and market\-mapping capability.
* Demonstrated ability to independently close senior/leadership mandates.
* Strong stakeholder management, assessment, negotiation and communication skills.
* Experience in senior\-level compensation benchmarking and offer closure.
* High professional maturity, judgement, confidentiality and ownership.
**Screening Questions**
-----------------------


Are you willing to work from Ahmedabad on a 6\-day working schedule?


Do you have hands\-on experience working with MS Excel?


Do you have experience working in any of the following industries: Solar, Renewable Energy, EPC, Engineering, Manufacturing, Infrastructure, Power or related industries or a similar industry involving extensive field sales/service operations?


Do you hold a Master’s degree/PG Diploma in Human Resources (HR) or a Graduate degree in Engineering?


What was the maximum number of direct reportees managed by you?


What is your current CTC ( LPA)?


What is your expected CTC ( LPA)?


What would be your expected joining days upon receiving the offer?


How many total years of experience do you have in Talent Acquisition / Recruitment?


How many years of hands\-on experience do you have specifically in Senior Management / Leadership / CXO hiring?


How many Senior Management / Leadership / CXO positions have you personally closed during the last 24 months?


Do you have advanced hands\-on experience using LinkedIn for executive search and passive\-candidate sourcing?


Have you independently conducted preliminary assessments/interviews of senior leadership candidates before presenting them to Management?


Have you managed compensation discussions/negotiations for Senior Management or leadership\-level candidates?


Have you conducted compensation benchmarking for senior/leadership positions?

title: IT Resume Specialist
description:
Resume Writer

**Job Type:** Full\-Time  
**Location:** Ahmedabad  
**Experience:** 1–3 years  
**Industry:** IT Recruitment / Career Services  
**Shift:** Overnight(US time zone)

Job Summary

We are looking for a skilled **Resume Writer** who can create, improve, and customize professional resumes for IT professionals. The ideal candidate should understand different IT roles, be able to identify candidates' key skills and experience, and present them effectively in ATS\-friendly resumes.

Key Responsibilities

* Create and update professional, ATS\-friendly resumes for IT candidates.
* Review candidates' experience, skills, projects, and career goals.
* Customize resumes according to specific IT job descriptions.
* Highlight relevant technical skills, achievements, and experience.
* Ensure resumes are professionally formatted, accurate, and easy to read.
* Optimize resumes with relevant keywords for ATS systems.
* Rewrite existing resumes to improve their impact and presentation.
* Work with recruiters and candidates to gather required information.
* Maintain quality and consistency across all resumes.
* Complete resumes within assigned timelines and meet daily/weekly targets.

Requirements

* 1–3 years of experience in resume writing, career services, recruitment, or a related field.
* Excellent written English and strong grammar skills.
* Strong knowledge of professional resume formatting and ATS optimization.
* Good understanding of IT/technical roles such as Software Developer, Data Engineer, DevOps, Cloud, Cybersecurity, QA, etc.
* Ability to understand technical experience and convert it into strong resume content.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Good communication and organizational skills.
* Ability to work with deadlines and handle multiple candidates.

Preferred Skills

* Experience creating resumes for the **US job market**.
* Familiarity with US IT recruitment and job descriptions.
* Experience using resume\-building or document\-formatting tools.
* Knowledge of ATS systems and keyword optimization.

What We Offer

* Competitive salary.
* Performance\-based incentives.
* Professional growth opportunities.
* Training and development.
* Dynamic and collaborative work environment.
* Opportunity to work with IT professionals and US\-based recruitment processes.

Work Location: In person
